assembler.tipsTitle: 📝 Don't forget the five writing principles
tips: Put the camera-move instruction first — never buried mid-description
Spell out both the starting frame and the ending frame
Add one speed word: slow / steady / fast
Camera move + mood keyword is the golden pair
For clips under 15 seconds, use at most 1–2 camera moves
